## New

- **Highest refresh rate** (on by default): the home screen, app drawer and recents ask Android for your screen's top rate, such as 120 Hz. Phones that only give their own list of apps the high rate, such as some Xiaomi, OnePlus and Oppo models, no longer hold TheLauncher at 60 Hz. Turn it off under **Interface → General** if you'd rather save battery.

- **Google feed on the left now works**, through a small companion app, **TheLauncher Feed**, attached to this release as `TheLauncher-Feed.apk`. The Google app only shows its feed to specially built apps, so every third-party launcher needs one of these (Nova, Lawnchair and Hyperion do too). Install it once, turn on **Show feed**, and swipe right on the home screen. If it isn't installed, the feed settings say so and offer the download.

## Fixed

- The app drawer search bar no longer goes see-through when you start typing; it keeps its colour, as in Hyperion.
